'''June 2001 Raleigh tournament (first event)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Raleigh, NC in June 2001. It is known from Edwin Harris's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2413">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-05-raleigh-ncd2413/ raleigh-nc], DeckTech (Edwin "Edwin" Harris, 5 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-05-raleigh-ncd2413/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' June 2001
* '''Site:''' Raleigh, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 20
